recognize_zh: G 帶染色的男性核型圖（XY），紅色箭頭標示第 1、11、13 號染色體的結構異常，而第 15 與 17 號看起來成對、未被標示；表示此 APL 病例的 PML::RARA 可能為隱匿性或複雜重組，需以 FISH 或 RT-PCR 確認。
features: Red arrows mark apparent structural abnormalities on one homolog each of chromosomes 1, 11, and 13
One chromosome 11 appears to carry additional material on the long arm
Chromosomes 15 and 17 are paired without an arrow or obvious rearrangement at this band resolution
Moderate banding resolution limits breakpoint assignment
describe_en: G-banded karyotype from a male shows arrows indicating structural abnormalities involving one homolog each of chromosomes 1, 11, and 13, with one chromosome 11 appearing to carry extra long-arm material. Chromosomes 15 and 17 are not flagged and show no obvious t(15;17) at this resolution, so exact breakpoints and partner chromosomes cannot be assigned from the image. In a case of acute promyelocytic leukemia, this suggests a complex or variant rearrangement or a cryptic PML::RARA fusion, which should be confirmed by FISH or RT-PCR.
